Contract LibraryManagementSystemSystem::countDownSuspensionDay() {
	definition:
		us: Set(User) = User.allInstance()->select(u|u.OverDueFee>0)
	precondition:
		User.allInstance()->exists(u|u.OverDueFee>0)
	postcondition:
		us->forAll(u|u.SuspensionDays = u.SuspensionDays@pre-1) and
		us->forAll(u|if u.SuspensionDays@pre<=1 
		then u.BorrowStatus = BorrowStatus::SUSPEND 
		else u.BorrowStatus = u.BorrowStatus@pre 
		endif )
}
